versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶ֧ל אֶלְעָזָ֛ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
controles.livre: E aconteceu depois da mortandade, que o SENHOR falou a Moisés, e a Eleazar filho do sacerdote Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: שְׂא֞וּ אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ׀ כָּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
controles.kjv: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
controles.livre: Tomai a soma de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, de vinte anos acima, pelas casas de seus pais, todos os que possam sair à guerra em Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֹתָ֖ם בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
controles.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
controles.livre: E Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote falaram com eles nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.”   These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: Contareis o povo de vinte anos acima, como mandou o SENHOR a Moisés e aos filhos de Israel, que haviam saído da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֗ן חֲנוֹךְ֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַחֲנֹכִ֔י לְפַלּ֕וּא מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפַּלֻּאִֽי׃

controles.web: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
controles.kjv: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
controles.livre: Rúben primogênito de Israel: os filhos de Rúben: Enoque, do qual era a família dos enoquitas; de Palu, a família dos paluítas;

versos.hebraico: לְחֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶצְרוֹנִ֑י לְכַרְמִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַכַּרְמִֽי׃

controles.web: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
controles.kjv: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
controles.livre: De Hezrom, a família dos hezronitas; de Carmi, a família dos carmitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias dos rubenitas: e seus contados foram quarenta e três mil setecentos e trinta.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י פַלּ֖וּא אֱלִיאָֽב׃

controles.web: The sons of Pallu: Eliab.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Palu: Eliabe.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֔ב נְמוּאֵ֖ל וְדָתָ֣ן וַאֲבִירָ֑ם הֽוּא־דָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם קרואי הָעֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצּ֜וּ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ בַּעֲדַת־קֹ֔רַח בְּהַצֹּתָ֖ם עַל־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they rebelled against Yahweh,
controles.kjv: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:
controles.livre: E os filhos de Eliabe: Nemuel, e Datã, e Abirão. Estes Datã e Abirão foram os do conselho da congregação, que fizeram o motim contra Moisés e Arão com a companhia de Coré, quando se amotinaram contra o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּפְתַּ֨ח הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־פִּ֗יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֛ם וְאֶת־קֹ֖רַח בְּמ֣וֹת הָעֵדָ֑ה בַּאֲכֹ֣ל הָאֵ֗שׁ אֵ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַיִּהְי֖וּ לְנֵֽס׃

controles.web: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
controles.kjv: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
controles.livre: Que a terra abriu sua boca e tragou a eles e a Coré, quando aquela companhia morreu, quando consumiu o fogo duzentos e cinquenta homens, os quais foram por sinal.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵי־קֹ֖רַח לֹא־מֵֽתוּ׃ס

controles.web: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
controles.livre: Mas os filhos de Coré não morreram.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעוֹן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִנְמוּאֵ֗ל מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַנְּמ֣וּאֵלִ֔י לְיָמִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּמִינִ֑י לְיָכִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּכִינִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
controles.kjv: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Simeão por suas famílias: de Nemuel, a família dos nemuelitas; de Jamim, a família dos jaminitas; de Jaquim, a família dos jaquinitas;

versos.hebraico: לְזֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַזַּרְחִ֑י לְשָׁא֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁאוּלִֽי׃

controles.web: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
controles.kjv: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
controles.livre: De Zerá, a família dos zeraítas; de Saul, a família dos saulitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֑י שְׁנַ֧יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias dos simeonitas, vinte e dois mil e duzentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י גָד֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִצְפ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַצְּפוֹנִ֔י לְחַגִּ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחַגִּ֑י לְשׁוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּנִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
controles.kjv: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Gade por suas famílias: de Zefom, a família dos zefonitas; de Hagi, a família dos hagitas; de Suni, a família dos sunitas;

versos.hebraico: לְאָזְנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאָזְנִ֑י לְעֵרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָעֵרִֽי׃

controles.web: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
controles.kjv: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
controles.livre: De Ozni, a família dos oznitas; de Eri, a família dos eritas;

versos.hebraico: לַאֲר֕וֹד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֲרוֹדִ֑י לְאַ֨רְאֵלִ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאַרְאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
controles.kjv: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
controles.livre: De Arodi, a família dos aroditas; de Areli, a família dos arelitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־גָ֖ד לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias de Gade, por seus contados, quarenta mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עֵ֣ר וְאוֹנָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מָת עֵ֛ר וְאוֹנָ֖ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
controles.kjv: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Judá: Er e Onã; e Er e Onã morreram na terra de Canaã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְשֵׁלָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַשֵּׁ֣לָנִ֔י לְפֶ֕רֶץ מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפַּרְצִ֑י לְזֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַזַּרְחִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
controles.livre: E foram os filhos de Judá por suas famílias: de Selá, a família dos selanitas; de Perez, a família dos perezitas; de Zerá, a família dos zeraítas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־פֶ֔רֶץ לְחֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶצְרֹנִ֑י לְחָמ֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הֶחָמוּלִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
controles.livre: E foram os filhos de Perez: de Hezrom, a família dos hezronitas; de Hamul, a família dos hamulitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of Judah according to those who were numbered of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias de Judá, por seus contados, setenta e seis mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֤י יִשָּׂשכָר֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם תּוֹלָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַתּוֹלָעִ֑י לְפֻוָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפּוּנִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Issacar por suas famílias: de Tola, a família dos tolaítas; de Puá a família dos puvitas;

versos.hebraico: לְיָשׁ֕וּב מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּשׁוּבִ֑י לְשִׁמְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְרֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
controles.kjv: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
controles.livre: De Jasube, a família dos jasubitas; de Sinrom, a família dos sinronitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias de Issacar, por seus contados, sessenta e quatro mil e trezentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְסֶ֗רֶד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַסַּרְדִּ֔י לְאֵל֕וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֵלֹנִ֑י לְיַ֨חְלְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיַּחְלְאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Zebulom por suas famílias: de Serede, a família dos sereditas; de Elom, a família dos elonitas; de Jaleel, a família dos jaleelitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַזְּבוּלֹנִ֖י לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias dos zebulonitas, por seus contados, sessenta mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶפְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
controles.kjv: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
controles.livre: Os filhos de José por suas famílias: Manassés e Efraim.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לְמָכִיר֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמָּכִירִ֔י וּמָכִ֖יר הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־גִּלְעָ֑ד לְגִלְעָ֕ד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגִּלְעָדִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Manassés: de Maquir, a família dos maquiritas; e Maquir gerou a Gileade; de Gileade, a família dos gileaditas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד אִיעֶ֕זֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאִֽיעֶזְרִ֑י לְחֵ֕לֶק מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶלְקִֽי׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Gileade: de Jezer, a família dos jezeritas; de Heleque, a família dos helequitas;

versos.hebraico: וְאַ֨שְׂרִיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽאַשְׂרִֽאֵלִ֑י וְשֶׁ֕כֶם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁכְמִֽי׃

controles.web: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
controles.kjv: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
controles.livre: De Asriel, a família dos asrielitas: de Siquém, a família dos siquemitas;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמִידָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִ֑י וְחֵ֕פֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶפְרִֽי׃

controles.web: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
controles.kjv: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
controles.livre: De Semida, a família dos semidaítas; de Héfer, a família dos heferitas.

versos.hebraico: וּצְלָפְחָ֣ד בֶּן־חֵ֗פֶר לֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וְשֵׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֔ד מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃

controles.web: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
controles.kjv: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
controles.livre: E Zelofeade, filho de Héfer, não teve filhos somente filhas: e os nomes das filhas de Zelofeade foram Maalá, e Noa, e Hogla, e Milca, e Tirza.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias de Manassés; e seus contados, cinquenta e dois mil e setecentos.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְשׁוּתֶ֗לַח מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַשֻּׁ֣תַלְחִ֔י לְבֶ֕כֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַבַּכְרִ֑י לְתַ֕חַן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽתַּחֲנִֽי׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Efraim por suas famílias: de Sutela, a família dos sutelaítas; de Bequer, a família dos bequeritas; de Taã, a família dos taanitas.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י שׁוּתָ֑לַח לְעֵרָ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָעֵרָנִֽי׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
controles.livre: E estes são os filhos de Sutela: de Erã, a família dos eranitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֤ת בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לִפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Efraim, por seus contados, trinta e dois mil e quinhentos. Estes são os filhos de José por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְבֶ֗לַע מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַבַּלְעִ֔י לְאַשְׁבֵּ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽאַשְׁבֵּלִ֑י לַאֲחִירָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֲחִירָמִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
controles.kjv: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Benjamim por suas famílias: de Belá, a família dos belaítas; de Asbel, a família dos asbelitas; de Airã, a família dos airamitas;

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁפוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּפָמִ֑י לְחוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַחוּפָמִֽי׃

controles.web: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
controles.kjv: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
controles.livre: De Sufã, a família dos sufamitas; de Hufã, a família dos hufamitas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־בֶ֖לַע אַ֣רְדְּ וְנַעֲמָ֑ן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הָֽאַרְדִּ֔י לְנַֽעֲמָ֔ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽנַּעֲמִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Belá foram Arde e Naamã: de Arde, a família dos arditas; de Naamã, a família dos naamanitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Benjamim por suas famílias; e seus contados, quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־דָן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לְשׁוּחָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּחָמִ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת דָּ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Dã por suas famílias: de Suã, a família dos suamitas. Estas são as famílias de Dã por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַשּׁוּחָמִ֖י לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Todas as famílias dos suamitas, por seus contados, sessenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁר֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְיִמְנָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַיִּמְנָ֔ה לְיִשְׁוִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיִּשְׁוִ֑י לִבְרִיעָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַבְּרִיעִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
controles.kjv: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Aser por suas famílias: de Imna, a família dos imnaítas; de Isvi, a família dos isvitas; de Berias, a família dos beriitas.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה לְחֶ֕בֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶבְרִ֑י לְמַ֨לְכִּיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Berias: de Héber, a família dos heberitas; de Malquiel, a família dos malquielitas.

versos.hebraico: וְשֵׁ֥ם בַּת־אָשֵׁ֖ר שָֽׂרַח׃

controles.web: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
controles.kjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
controles.livre: E o nome da filha de Aser foi Sera.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־אָשֵׁ֖ר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Aser, por seus contados, cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֤י נַפְתָּלִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לְיַ֨חְצְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיַּחְצְאֵלִ֑י לְגוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגּוּנִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Naftali por suas famílias: de Jazeel, a família dos jazeelitas; de Guni, a família dos gunitas;

versos.hebraico: לְיֵ֕צֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיִּצְרִ֑י לְשִׁלֵּ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִֽי׃

controles.web: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
controles.kjv: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
controles.livre: De Jezer, a família dos jezeritas; de Silém, a família dos silemitas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias de Naftali por suas famílias; e seus contados, quarenta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֗לֶּה פְּקוּדֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וָאָ֑לֶף שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃פ

controles.web: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
controles.kjv: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
controles.livre: Estes são os contados dos filhos de Israel, seiscentos e um mil setecentos e trinta.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: לָאֵ֗לֶּה תֵּחָלֵ֥ק הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמֽוֹת׃

controles.web: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
controles.kjv: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
controles.livre: A estes se repartirá a terra em herança, pela conta dos nomes.

versos.hebraico: לָרַ֗ב תַּרְבֶּה֙ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ וְלַמְעַ֕ט תַּמְעִ֖יט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י פְקֻדָ֔יו יֻתַּ֖ן נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.
controles.kjv: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
controles.livre: Aos mais darás maior herança, e aos menos menor; e a cada um se lhe dará sua herança conforme seus contados.

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־בְּגוֹרָ֕ל יֵחָלֵ֖ק אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ לִשְׁמ֥וֹת מַטּוֹת־אֲבֹתָ֖ם יִנְחָֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
controles.livre: Porém a terra será repartida por sorteio; e pelos nomes das tribos de seus pais herdarão.

versos.hebraico: עַל־פִּי֙ הַגּוֹרָ֔ל תֵּחָלֵ֖ק נַחֲלָת֑וֹ בֵּ֥ין רַ֖ב לִמְעָֽט׃ס

controles.web: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
controles.kjv: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
controles.livre: Conforme a sorte será repartida sua herança entre o grande e o pequeno.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֣י הַלֵּוִי֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְגֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י לִקְהָ֕ת מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקְּהָתִ֑י לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמְּרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: These are those who were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
controles.kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
controles.livre: E os contados dos levitas por suas famílias são estes: de Gérson, a família dos gersonitas; de Coate, a família dos coatitas; de Merari, a família dos meraritas.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת לֵוִ֗י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת הַלִּבְנִ֜י מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽחֶבְרֹנִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַמַּחְלִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקָּרְחִ֑י וּקְהָ֖ת הוֹלִ֥ד אֶת־עַמְרָֽם׃

controles.web: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias dos levitas: a família dos libnitas, a família dos hebronitas, a família dos malitas, a família dos musitas, a família dos coraítas. E Coate gerou a Anrão.

versos.hebraico: וְשֵׁ֣ם׀ אֵ֣שֶׁת עַמְרָ֗ם יוֹכֶ֨בֶד֙ בַּת־לֵוִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֥ה אֹתָ֛הּ לְלֵוִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעַמְרָ֗ם אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת מִרְיָ֥ם אֲחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
controles.kjv: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
controles.livre: E a mulher de Anrão se chamou Joquebede, filha de Levi, a qual nasceu a Levi no Egito: esta deu à luz de Anrão a Arão e a Moisés, e a Miriã sua irmã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶת־נָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֲבִיה֑וּא אֶת־אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־אִיתָמָֽר׃

controles.web: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
controles.kjv: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
controles.livre: E a Arão nasceram Nadabe e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥מָת נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִיה֑וּא בְּהַקְרִיבָ֥ם אֵשׁ־זָרָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
controles.livre: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram, quando ofereceram fogo estranho diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כָּל־זָכָ֖ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה כִּ֣י׀ לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא־נִתַּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E os contados dos levitas foram vinte e três mil, todos homens de um mês acima: porque não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel, porquanto não lhes havia de ser dada herança entre os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
controles.kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
controles.livre: Estes são os contados por Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote, os quais contaram os filhos de Israel nos campos de Moabe, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.

versos.hebraico: וּבְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ לֹא־הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

controles.web: But among these there was not a man of them who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.kjv: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.livre: E entre estes ninguém havia dos contados por Moisés e Arão o sacerdote, os quais contaram aos filhos de Israel no deserto de Sinai.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם מ֥וֹת יָמֻ֖תוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְלֹא־נוֹתַ֤ר מֵהֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֚י אִם־כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃ס

controles.web: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.kjv: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR lhes disse: Hão de morrer no deserto: e não restou homem deles, a não ser Calebe filho de Jefoné, e Josué filho de Num.
